source_review.scope: Read four helper sources and relevant actual Adapter guard/prepare/release functions, compile only; no helper/module import or execution. Release is exclusive bytecopy of reviewed template, candidate write atomic, once-intent/partial rerun refused. No model/runtime/protocol/queue/experiment/admission mutations occur in these helpers.
